text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything. Panels are often skewed by chance or by who holds HR and senior roles; a four-person panel drawn from a female-majority leadership pool is unremarkable. Raising it would make you look aggrieved and would undercut the one genuinely strong point you have.

Note also that director roles are frequently filled on political judgement, council relations and consultation skill rather than technical depth — the stated rationale is plausible on its face, not a pretext signal.

Pursue the real issue: the unanswered request. Follow up in writing, cite any access-to-information or recruitment-policy right to feedback, and ask for the scoring matrix. Judge the decision on what that document shows.
